invariants.rationale: A non-null instantTime is typically required for scheduling compaction, as it identifies the compaction instant.
A non-null HoodieEngineContext is generally required for any table operation.
Option should not be null at method entry, as Option is used for presence/absence semantics.
An empty instantTime string would not represent a valid scheduling instant.
If extraMetadata is present, the underlying map should be non-null for compaction metadata.
